purpose: Teach: 終る/顧み/ためらい/程遠い/まるっきり/ひとたび/きまり/だいじょうぶ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、テストが終るとゲームばっかだろ
lines.en: Riku, you do realize all you do after tests is play games, right?
lines.style: Knowing, affectionate jab. Light and teasing on the opening. Quick pace, like she's poking him and moving on. No malice underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、過去を顧みても始まらないだろ、桜
lines.en: You can't change the past, Sakura. No point dwelling on it.
lines.style: Quiet and measured. Gentle deflection — not trying to win, just trying to be steady. Looking away slightly, choosing words carefully. Small breath before the name.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、告白にためらいがあんだろ?
lines.en: Riku, come on — you're hesitating about something big, aren't you?
lines.style: Perceptive and pressing. Less teasing now, more seeing through him. Leans forward slightly. Softer on the question, like she's giving him an opening.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、満点には程遠いけど、まあ頑張ったな、桜
lines.en: Your score wasn't perfect, but hey — you actually tried. That's something, Sakura.
lines.style: Turning it back on her with quiet sincerity. Warm redirect. Slight smile in the voice without making it obvious. The praise lands because he doesn't oversell it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、まるっきり数学やってないだろ
lines.en: Riku, you basically didn't study math at all, did you?
lines.style: Exasperated but not angry. Lighter touch than before — she's noticing the pattern, not attacking it. A little resignation mixed with the teasing. Trails slightly on the question.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ひとたび部活始めたらやめないよな、桜
lines.en: Once you commit to something, you stick with it. That's just who you are, Sakura.
lines.style: Stating a fact he's observed. Genuine, not flattery. Steady pace. A small note of respect underneath. Not performing — just saying what he sees.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、学校のきまり守れよ
lines.en: Look — just follow the school rules, okay?
lines.style: Direct but not harsh. Brief and sincere. Like a friend giving actual advice, not lecturing. Light firmness on the opening word.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テストだいじょうぶか、桜
lines.en: Are you actually okay with how the test went?
lines.style: Close and quiet. Genuine worry underneath casual tone. Lean-in conversational. Waiting for a real answer, not a brush-off.
